services.name: Adult Sailing
services.desc: The Monmouth Boat Club Saturday Sail Program is intended to be a way for members to go out for a day sail with other members. It is open to all members regardless of sailing ability or boat ownership status. We want to connect skippers and crew so everyone can enjoy the Navesink. Qualified skippers can reserve a club boat. Sailboat owners, racers, daysailers, and cruisers can either use their own boat or if qualified reserve a club boat. We will meet at club to decide boat assignments 15 min before the start time. services.name: MBC Virtual Lessons
services.desc: During the pandemic, when even outdoors we could only sail with family members, the Navesink NautiGals hosted virtual sailing lessons. Many MBC experts prepared lessons and materials. While many of the lectures did not age well, some of the materials and animations have proved to be valuable adjunct resources to on-the-water instruction! These resources are focused on the novice who isn't quite comfortable racing or sailing, but wants to learn more and become a more comfortable sailor. blurb: Historic Monmouth Boat Club, located on the Navesink River in downtown Red Bank, NJ, was founded in 1879, making it one of the oldest clubs in the country. For more than 145 years we have been welcoming new members and their families. You will find a friendly atmosphere of large and small boat sailors, rowers, kayakers, paddle boarders, and power boaters.
